Mr. I. C. Herried Page 2 February 17, 1975
. . .
In addition to the system planning effort, airport master planning for improvement of facilities at General Mitchell Field to the year 1995 is currently underway. Further, the Commission, in its clearinghouse review of runway reconstruction improvements at General Mitchell Field, has indicated that these applications for federal funds are not in conflict with the regional airport system plan which, to date, supports continued commercial aviation activities within the Region at General Mitchell Field.
We trust that this information will be helpful in clarifying the role of General Mitchell Field in support of implementation of the Airport Spur Freeway element of the adopted transportation plans within southeastern Wisconsin.
Sincerely,
Kurt W. Bauer Executive Director
